verdict.rationale: Cloudflare API Tokens explicitly support scoping to specific resource groups and permission levels (Account/User/Zone) with granular examples like Zone DNS Read for a single zone, and this scoped-token mechanism is documented as the recommended way for agents/automation to authenticate (CI/CD bearer tokens for MCP servers, agent OAuth flows with selectable permission grants). Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification of least-privilege enforcement in practice, and no dedicated 'agent identity' credential type distinct from general API tokens.
